name: portal_sidpol
description: Portal SIDPOL: backend (Express) en backend/ y frontend (Angular) en frontend/sidpol-app/

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/sidpol-app install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend/sidpol-app run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend/sidpol-app test -- --watch=false
